answer.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification experiment focused on SMB and self-serve accounts. Shortened onboarding has confirmed gains in completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, supporting sustainable revenue better than reacting with broad discounts. Avoid promotional pricing because it lifted acquisition but materially harmed 30-day retention. Monitor qualified revenue, retention, and churn by segment; the prior signup simplification result included a small retention decline and did not generalize beyond SMB.
